question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the Wave 2+ modular dashboard roadmap as a bundled Control UI direction, and which storage/security boundaries must the child issues and PRs follow?
rationale: The request adds broad user-facing dashboard capability, persistent state, widget distribution, and untrusted browser execution surfaces; code inspection can show current gaps, but cannot choose the product and security posture for that roadmap.

options.title: Sponsor the roadmap with gates
options.body: Keep the umbrella and child issues open, then review the PRs in order with explicit storage, security, proof, and plugin-boundary requirements before merge.

options.title: Narrow to core seams only
options.body: Accept only generic plugin/API gaps that unblock external dashboard work and ask dashboard-specific widgets, skills, and gallery pieces to live outside core until sponsored.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the child issues unimplemented or close the stack if maintainers decide dashboard composition is not current roadmap work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the roadmap with gates
recommendation.body: Keep the umbrella and child issues open, then review the PRs in order with explicit storage, security, proof, and plugin-boundary requirements before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current routing signal for the Control UI/product seam and is CODEOWNERS-listed for repository ownership.
